164044.description:
The first of two early works one-shot compilations by Minori Kimura, this collects works from her latter half of high school through college, with one one-shot from her 20's at the end. Common themes include waiting, loneliness, and the psychology of children.

1. Rain (雨, Ame) - A boy is falsely accused of tearing a classmate's photo, but things don't seem to favor his truth. This boy is no stranger to lies and falsehoods, however...
2. Tommy (トミィ) - Tommy is a boy whose father perished during the war. Though the truth is hidden from him, Tommy begins to notice something is off....
3. Balloon (風船, Fuusen) - A largely silent one-shot about a girl who longs for the embodiment of joy: balloons.
4. Tunnel (トンネル) - A recollection of one's time when he was a young boy, and a tunnel that only he felt fear toward.
5. Carrot (にんじん, Ninjin) - A reflection on one's dislike for carrots when he was a young boy, and a certain incident regarding that.
6. Mamoru-kun is Dead (まもる君が死んだ, Mamoru-kun ga Shinda) - A whole town investigates what happened to one young boy, while also reflecting upon the wrongs done to him.
7. A Joyful Tale (こうふくな話, Koufuku na Hanashi) - Kimura reflects upon the aspects of her younger self that she has now lost. The only one-shot not in a shojo magazine, instead published in COM.
8. The Wingless Bird (翼のない鳥, Tsubasa no nai Tori) - The tale of Joey, a country boy who has always wished to fly since he was very young. Joey departs from home, wanting to find out a way in which he can fly, but he discovers much more in the wide world he explores.

In his early writing days, Minami resented his editor's suggestion to try his hand at male-on-male romance. He'd never had much passion for anything⁠—in work or in his (mostly non-existent) personal life. He thought he didn't need love. Meanwhile, though, the young masseur can't get enough of him! But on his way back home with a broken heart, he ends up slipping from the top of a building and plummeting…to his premature death. Then a surprisingly young grim reaper shows up to collect his soul. But luckily enough, the reaper messes things up…and Seowoo is given the chance to stay in the corporeal world for a bit longer. There’s just one catch: the reaper is to move in with Seowoo and make sure he stays out of trouble and the lives of the living. 164413.description:

Roseny has been masquerading as a boy for years at the orphanage. But when the duke chooses her to be a playmate for his son, it isn't long before her secret is revealed. Instead of being sent back, her adorable complexion results in Roseny being adopted! What will this new future hold for her?

(Source: Manta)

164414.description:
The princess, who knew her abilities were extraordinary but knew that she would not become the king, wanted to spend the rest of her life quietly with her maid.

He touches the maid, and the maid disappears.

The moment she touches the maid who truly cares for them among those who have spent their entire lives in the palace telling lies for their own benefit, the extraordinary serpent stretches to become a dragon that leaps over the Imoogi to protect his people.

“The princess of the present country will unify the three kingdoms.”

In a country built with the consideration of God and the kindness of dragons, human greed and power were stained by the dragon's curse, and the war was scheduled to begin with prophecy.

Can a princess really become an emperor?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

164415.description:
Imagine Lee Sangyeo's surprise when she wakes up one day inside her favorite novel... and her horror when she realizes she's in the body of the adorable heroine's evil sister-in-law, Aylee Brydon! Knowing that the story will end terribly if nothing changes, Aylee is determined to save the heroine at all costs. However, her complete character reversal leads to problems in high society and causes friction with her cold fiancé, Duke Van Drave. At this rate, Aylee might be the one who needs saving!

(Source: Tapas)

164416.description:
Once Crown Princess of the Empire of Kotrov, Adelheid is reduced to a political pawn by her own mother when she is married off to Emperor Karl Ulrich Echmont of the faraway Echmont Empire. Expecting little from her new life, the reality she faces is even bleaker; not only is her new husband distrustful of her, but Adelheid must also contend with the jealousy of his concubine Diane. Thus begins Adelheid’s journey to gain allies in court, while also using her hidden mage powers to combat a rising threat…

Amidst the chaos, the terrifying Marquess Max Warren saves her life. Grateful, she enters his service as a maid. Despite the potential communication gap, the two have no problem understanding each other. Not so much for the other nobles though, who grow suspicious of their bond. Xia Wan never expected to be exposed, threatened, and caressed… all after getting involved with Qingcheng's mysterious legendary bachelor Huo Qingsui. Huo Qingsui's only goal for his relationship with Xia Wan: to dote on her and cherish her for a lifetime.

In Year Zero of the ZO era, Randall, the village doctor, discovers a mysterious virus that is spreading through the village. One by one, the infected villagers become zombies, or "Z," and now humanity must fight to defeat Alpha, the creator of the Z virus…

(Source: Natalie, translated)

164518.description:
Clarabelle, who grew up in the countryside, skipped a grade to enter the academy in the royal capital in pursuit of her fiancé Alan, who is from the same hometown. But as soon as she enters the school, she witnesses Alan cheating on her! He dismissed her, saying "I have no love for a plain, unsophisticated woman like you."

As Clarabelle was still crying from the shocking breakup, Victoria, the third prince's fiancée, consoles her. Victoria takes her to the student council chamber, where she meets Lloyd, a handsome but foul-mouthed classmate.

"I want a makeover, and become a proper lady."

Starting with her encounter with Lloyd and Victoria, Clarabelle will embark on new lessons to find her true love destiny!

(Source: Kurofune Pixiv, translated)

164520.description:
Im Hyeon-Seong was a famous chef and restaurateur until he met his untimely death at the hands of his family. In his final moments, he is given the chance to get revenge, but only if he completes a special quest: save the failing idol group Climax as its leader, Cheon I-Se! Equipped with Hyeon-Seong’s entrepreneurial and cooking skills, will I-Se pull the group together and help Climax rise to the top for a successful comeback? Or will the group–and his new life–be on the chopping block?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

164521.description:
To flee from her abusive family, Evelyn Diego pretends to be a goddess from a prophecy and tricks the blind Grand Duke Devan Lantimos into believing she can lift his curse. Unfortunately, her powers fail to heal him completely, and things get even more complicated as she discovers that Devan's curse isn't quite what she thought it was. With time running out and her family looking for her, will Evelyn be able to cure Devan and get the freedom she so desperately wants?

(Source: Tapas)

164522.description:
Io starts working as a lord's valet in the guise of his older twin brother Ces. Lord Kazar has closed off his heart completely in the wake of his friend's betrayal. Undeterred by Kazar's cold demeanor, Io works hard to serve his master, who gradually begins to crack smiles. However, as he and Kazar grow closer, Io starts having misgivings about deceiving his master about his identity....

As well as the popular digital series, this manga includes a story that has never been published before. In total, there are six stories: "Time for a Kiss, Master", "Tell Me, Master", "Don't Let Me Go, Master", "Time to Wake Up, My Princess", "Love Talk", and "Stay by My Side".

(Source: Renta!)

164523.description:
The man who piqued his interest is his junior.

Two men with different ages and different views on love get drawn to each other. A clumsy, roundabout, and earnest love. A young trendy model and a closeted fashion magazine editor.

Mihara You was recently transferred from the literature to the fashion department. He attends the trendy model Usui Sakumi’s photoshoot.

“I’ve seen you before.” After the photoshoot, Usui tells him how their first meeting took place, leaving You embarrassed. During another meeting, Usui asks him about the reason for why he was crying at that time. After telling Usui he had been dumped, Usui gets swept up by his honesty and ends up kissing You.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

164524.description:
Eleanor, a beta nobleman, finally weds his beloved Fenrir—but his joy is short-lived. Unable to bear children, he becomes a source of shame to the family and, overcome with despair, throws himself from a window. But instead of death, he wakes up as an omega… on the morning of his wedding day. With no idea how or why he’s turned back time—or changed sexes—Eleanor must navigate a new reality where his body, instincts, and even his relationship with Fenrir are shifting. As if that weren’t enough, three powerful alphas begin circling him with growing interest. In this second life, will Eleanor protect his love… or be swept into an entirely new destiny?

(Source: Lezhin US)

164525.description:
"Listen carefully, I'm a bit of a pervert."
"What?"
“So I want Hyung to do as I tell you.”

One day, Do Jaewon of the popular idol group "Majors" saw Cheon Eunho, a member of the same group, masturbating using his video. Realizing that Eunho has a crush on him, Jaewon starts a sexual relationship with him out of curiosity. However, before he knows it, he becomes more and more sincere...

What will be the end of the scandal between the two 'Cherry Dolls', who just began to know each other?

(Source: Naver, translated)

164526.description:
Dawn, who lost his parents when he was young, visits the address of a letter from the past to know the circumstances surrounding the death of his parents. There, he met 'Hames' and lived with him. After a while, he felt affection for him. One day, as he spends his peaceful days with him, Dawn finds out that the person who killed his parents was Hames himself...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

In the residential area of the royal capital, a socially anxious apprentice witch, Miranda, manages the storefront of an enchanted medicines and sundries shop. Her quiet life is interrupted when an invitation to a royal tea party arrives.

At the palace’s greenhouse, she encounters Prince Heinrich—but…as a cat?! Cursed to take the form of a fluffy feline, he then shockingly requests her to become his keeper! Thus begins the slightly suggestive tale of a witch with a handsome prince as a familiar!

(Source: Manga UP!)

164529.description:
They call him a "rat." A burglar, but a chivalrous one, stealing from the rich to give from the poor. Ever since the thief slipped past Kyube's defenses, the only thing that's been on his mind is catching him, even if it's the last thing he does. One day, Kyube sees the mysterious, good-looking Kikuzo make his way into the White Camellia Mansion - where he last drove the thief into! Does Kikuzo have anything to do with Kyube's missing fugitive?

(Source: Manga Planet)

164530.description:
After Cinderella rejects the crown prince's proposal and elopes with a magician, her older sister Adelina gets forced to take her place. Although the popular and handsome prince marries Adelina, he tells her he does not intend on falling in love with her. Adelina could care less, however. To her, all that matters is that she be able to enjoy living quietly with her adorable animals at the royal villa, eventually getting an amicable divorce and a ton of alimony. Who cares if the prince gets a mistress or two? But the prince, who didn't care for Adelina at all, begins to show some interest in her...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

164531.description:
Tiana's engagement was broken off by the prince of her own country, and she was sentenced to exile. However, the knight of a neighbouring country, who was an aide to that country's prince, suddenly proposed to her. Since he was her type, Tiana accepted the marriage proposal and traveled with him to his country, but what awaited her was an unjust death. However, although she should have died, Tiana finds herself back when her engagement was broken and she was proposed to by the knight!
"Now... Now it's too late... I'll have to kill her."
The last words the knight spoke before killing her lingered in her mind. But Tiana doesn't want to die again! Terrified, she tries to refuse the marriage proposal, but she can't escape from the knight who has gone completely crazy! A cat-and-mouse rom-com about Tiana, whose memories construe murderous intent, and a knight who refuses to let her escape and gets more and more yandere...

As a reward for saving his subordinate’s life, gang boss Kang Cheol receives a coupon for a super-secret massage club. Tense from a long battle, he visits the massage parlor in hope to get a little R&R - only to be given a change of clothes that is bit too revealing, and a masseuse that is a little too handsy…

(Source: Lezhin US)

164533.description:
Numasuke, a shinobi in a town in Edo Japan, accepts secret letters from the Roju (elder of the town) to deliver to the young Tono (Lord of the town). Numasuke is ordered to never have the letter robbed or the contents read by others. He is then suddenly "hugged" by the elder and told to "convey this message too". Numasuke accepts that it must be an important code and conveys the "hug" to the Lord, but receives a "kiss" from the Lord in return...? What is the fate of Numasuke as the orders gradually become more radical...?!

(Source: MUGENUP)

title.native: 密書でござる！－隠密好色奮闘記－

164534.description:
Can a single night with a single person change your life forever? Hyeon-oh’s answer to this question is yes. Ever since a night he spent with Seo-hyun, he’s clung onto the memories of it to keep himself going in the dark world of the yakuza. Years later, Seo-hyun appears in his life once more. Could it be a sign that dawn is here to chase the darkness away once and for all?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Agent Kwon Taek-Ju is dispatched to Russia with two tasks. First, he must find “Anastasia,” a new weapon that could change the world forever. Second, he is to avoid Russia’s psychotic killer, Psikh Bognadov, at all costs. To assist him on his undercover mission, Taek-Ju is sent a partner who only reveals himself to be a man named Zhenya. But Zhenya quickly proves himself to be just as dangerous and unhinged as the infamous Psikh himself. Just who could he truly be? And will Taek-Ju succeed in tracking down “Anastasia”?

A man was hanging out in the park, depressed about the boss who took credit for all his work, when a drunken, big-breasted JD shows up! She listens to our hero's situation, and proposes, "I'll be oji-san's girlfriend for a day!" The innocent girl takes him to the arcade, karaoke, a movie... and end up at a love hotel! He is a nice guy who is confused by the situation, but she's happy to get down as a "reward for all his hard work"....

When he met his first love again, she turned out to be his girlfriend's mother! Hiding from his girlfriend, Sae and Junsuke drown in their forbidden love. But when Hanao finally finds out, that's when the mother-daughter threesome begins!

164539.description:
Yuzo Karita is 81 years old. He lives on a meager pension. His only emotional support is his beloved dog, Momo. Karita is happy as long as he can be with Momo. One day, during a medical checkup, Karita is told that he has only one year left to live. With his remaining time, he desperately tries to find a foster home for Momo. What fate awaits Karita and Momo?

This is a moving tale of an old man, his dog, and the deep bond between them that will touch the heart of anyone who reads it.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

164542.description: When Hijiri – black sheep of his family – finally snaps and kills his little brother, all he expects is persecution. What he didn’t expect is a mysterious whale only visible to him to show up and change the course of events…

164543.description:
Sinned heroes will save this world...

Being sentenced to Heroship was the most severe punishment one could be given. Heroes would be sent to the frontline of a never-ending battle against the demon lords. Not even death could relieve them on their duty.

There was no end to prison sentence. Even if they fought for a hundred years, they would still not be released. Only by killing every last demon lord would they be pardoned for their crimes. And...that was no more than a pipe dream. However, things might be different for XYRO, Penal Hero Unit 9004. He accidentally meets a goddess...and she asks him to be her knight!

(Source: KADOKAWA Global)

Gu Xuanchen, king of his time, once trained ten powerful emperor-realm disciples who were dominant in the world. However, when he broke through the shackles sealed in his own body, he unfortunately encountered a calamity of thunder and was destroyed. After being reborn as a son-in-law, he embarked on a journey to return to the peak and strengthen himself by slaying demons and monsters, suppressing evil spirits, saving his clan, and rescuing his disciples. Let\'s see how this almighty emperor is reborn and how he stirs up the world!

164547.description:
Yuuki, a music student, has a crush on Takeshi, a piano prodigy who is 10 years older than him. Yuuki has been crazy about the tone of Takeshi's piano since the first time he heard him play, but he has kept his feelings hidden ever since he realized that it is love. One day, a simple remark leads Yuuki to go live with Takeshi at his house in Vienna! Takeshi says he can't refuse Yuuki's request. So when Yuuki gets drunk one night, he ends up begging Takeshi to kiss him...?

(Source: Daria, translated)

164548.description:
Kim Hayeon was just covering for a friend at their day job when she unexpectedly ends up inside cellist Ji Sehun’s private waiting room. Despite his immense musical talent, Sehun is aloof and cold-hearted, and doesn’t take kindly to Hayeon’s intrusion. Though he accuses her of attempted theft, he cannot get her out of his mind, and attempts to court her. But while Hayeon may be timid, she is not easily won over. If this cellist isn’t careful, he may end up being the one getting played.

(Source: Tapas)

Kosaka and Okano ride their bikes together to school every morning. But after they are put into different classes in their third year of high school, their relationship seems to have become complicated...?

One day, the protagonist, who is short, a virgin, and has no girlfriend, is reunited with his childhood friend, Serena, who has become a gal. While rejoicing at the unexpected reunion, the protagonist is doused with a love potion he had made himself in order to get rid of his virginity! On his way home, he gets tangled up with Serena again, but the mote medicine he smells on her suddenly makes her go into heat and......!

Hwa-Yeon’s marriage hasn’t been a happy one. Her husband’s always away on business, not to mention the fact that he’s always sleeping with other women. She’s had enough—she’s going to have her fun. She’s going to go back to the days where she’d party all night. She’s back with a bang, so you’d all better brace yourselves!

(Source: Lezhin X)

164557.description:
Yoo Sora has been single ever since her ex-boyfriend Kim Woojin cruelly ghosted her. When Woojin shows up out of the blue asking for a favor, Sora is reluctant, but willing to help for the sake of old times. He owes money to some powerful gangsters, and to pay it back all she has to do is participate in a wrestling event while wearing a bikini. Seems easy enough…but why is this alley so dark and shady. And Why is Woojin’s expression suddenly so cold…?

(Source: Lezhin X)

The protagonist falls in love with his stepmother, Yuno, whom his father remarried. He and his stepdaughter, Sarara, start a new family of four, but the father married his daughter for her body! The protagonist's uncontrollable feelings for her stepmother and Yuno's frustration at not being embraced by her father lead to a physical relationship.

(Source: Mujin Comics, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Mugen Tensei 2023-05, 07.

She's a plain, 27-year-old office lady, who got caught up with a drunk in front of her house. She was scared that he was going to force his way into her house, but a passing postal worker saved her. But then he hugged her and they ended up having a one-night stand.... When the drunk next door started stalking her, he ended up taking her in to live with him. 164632.description:
The Dragon Dynasty, an ancient country with a long and deep history, is becoming increasingly prosperous thanks to the invention of the perpetual motion machine. Like a locomotive, the Never-Ending Machine guides the city in its quest for change and innovation.

The story centers on a hero named Long Zhengyi, who has suffered severe memory loss. After waking up in an unknown city, he gradually discovers the hidden truth of the country through the notes he had written before - Dragon Metropolis is nothing but a big cake divided by the great powers. The rotten darkness beneath the surface is the devastation caused by the perpetual motion machine. Moreover, what he discovers in the notes warns him to leave the dying city as soon as possible.

Transmigrated as the doomed villainess Aida Mortemer, Yao faces a peculiar challenge in a magical world. Enrolled in a magic academy without magical abilities, her plans to charm the main characters are slightly derailed when she encounters the demon lord's reincarnation. Desperate to survive and avoid her painful demise, Aida also befriends the formidable Miss Demon Lord, only to find her behavior increasingly...odd? 164634.description:
After Japan lost the War, the country was thrown into devastation. And no one felt this devastation as much as its women, who were forced into menial jobs, fell into sex work, and pawned off as war brides to American G.I.s. In their affecting graphic novel debut, Marina Lisa Komiya follows the lives of two Japanese women and the American soldiers they marry in this tumultuous time period.

Best friends (and possibly more) before the War, Haru and Yoriko are separated in the evacuation of their town during the air raids. As they search for each other afterward, Haru gets by as a waitress, while Yoriko sells her body at a brothel. Their fortunes change when they each meet respectful American soldiers, who take their hand. Arthur, a Japanese American, grapples with the inner conflict of his dual identity, while Scott is at once fascinated by Japanese culture and wracked with guilt over the destruction American forces have wrought.

Amidst the postwar desolation, love finds a way, in this powerful work of manga that explores sexuality, identity, and unlikely cross-cultural connection.

(Source: Fantagraphics)

After the incident, Tatsu becomes obsessed with the idea of eternal life, and he believes that killing a large number of snakes will give him immortality. Despite being treated as a "weirdo" by everyone, Momo keeps on looking after Tatsu. But after one wrong word said, the two friends get into a fierce argument and get into a surprising fight, leaving their families and normal everyday lives behind.
